name: Google-Lover
effect: The altered model writes like a smaller, older generic assistant. It drops the normal model's rich markdown headers for plain prose or short numbered lists and says less. It makes factual slips: Romeo's father is called Lord Capulet, Romeo
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Near miss: judged alone, it failed only the strict specificity check. A random neuron (sham control).
